items.title: File Widerspruch against rehabilitation rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen. Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: The letter states its own deemed-delivery rule (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): the Bescheid counts as bekannt gegeben on the 4th day after the stated Versandtag. Versandtag printed = Samstag, 21.11.2026 (not the Bescheiddatum of 18.11.2026). Counting the 4th day after 21.11.2026 (day of dispatch not counted): 22.11. (1), 23.11. (2), 24.11. (3), 25.11.2026 (4) → deemed delivery = Wed 25.11.2026. For social-law dispatch this day is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend (it does not here, Wed). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) starts the day after deemed delivery, i.e. 26.11.2026, and ends under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 25.12.2026 (Fri). 25.12.2026 is Erster Weihnachtstag, a public holiday in Hessen (the Rentenversicherung's seat, Gießen); 26.12. (2. Weihnachtsfeiertag) and 27.12. (Sunday) are also non-working, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline moves to the next working day: Mon 28.12.2026.

warnings: The Bescheid is dated 18.11.2026 but the printed Versandtag (actual dispatch date used for the statutory delivery-fiction) is Saturday 21.11.2026 — three days later than the Bescheid date; the Widerspruch deadline was computed from the later, printed Versandtag as the letter itself instructs.

The sender's registered seat (Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen) is in Hessen, not in the recipient's home Land NRW; Hessian public holidays were used for the deadline that must be met at the sender's office.
